serena.$comment: Semantic code navigation and persistent project memories. Uses installed binary — NOT uvx (too slow, exceeds MCP timeout).

context7.$comment: Up-to-date documentation and code examples via Context7

playwright.$comment: Headed Chrome via @playwright/mcp@latest. Default persistent workspace-hashed profile; no --isolated unless PLAYWRIGHT_ISOLATED=1. Launcher preloads klai-portal/frontend/e2e/prod-tenant/_config/storageState.voys.json when present, then falls back to ~/.claude/mcp-storageState.json. Voys/voice/real-user testing: npm run e2e:verify-voys-session then npm run test:e2e:prod:voys. Isolated e2e/testomgeving: source .env.local then npm run test:e2e:prod. See docs/setup/mcp-servers.md Section 3.

codeindex.$comment: Graph-powered code intelligence. Launcher runs an advisory health check only; it must not rebuild or restart MCP during stdio startup. Manual fix: scripts/codeindex-health.sh --repair; disruptive reset for stuck existing agents: scripts/codeindex-health.sh --repair --restart-mcp

grafana.$comment: AI agent access to Grafana dashboards, metrics queries, and alerts. Read-only. VictoriaLogs queries use the dedicated victorialogs MCP instead. Launcher maps GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN -> GRAFANA_API_KEY.

victorialogs.$comment: LogsQL queries against VictoriaLogs. Launcher opens a per-MCP-process SSH tunnel on a free local port, so parallel agent sessions do not share localhost:9428. Binary must be at ~/bin/mcp-victorialogs (Mac) or %USERPROFILE%\bin\mcp-victorialogs.exe (Windows). Set VICTORIALOGS_BASIC_AUTH_B64 in shell profile.
